title: Model Inversion Attacks: A Survey of Approaches and Countermeasures
abstract: arXiv:2411.10023v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep neural networks have enabled numerous studies and applications on both Euclidean data, such as images and text, and non-Euclidean data, such as graphs. Because these networks may process private data, their deployment raises concerns about privacy leakage. Model inversion attacks (MIAs) exploit access to a trained model to reconstruct training examples or infer privacy-sensitive characteristics represented by the model. The effectiveness of MIAs has been demonstrated in various domains, including images, text, and graphs. These attacks highlight the vulnerability of neural networks and raise awareness about the risk of privacy leakage within the research community. This survey provides a threat-model- and assumption-aware synthesis of attacks and defenses. translated_title: 模型反演攻击：方法与对策综述
translated_abstract: 摘要：深度神经网络已在欧几里得数据（如图像和文本）和非欧几里得数据（如图）上催生了众多研究与应用。由于这些网络可能处理私有数据，其部署引发了隐私泄露的担忧。模型反演攻击（MIAs）利用对训练模型的访问权限，重建训练样本或推断模型所代表的隐私敏感特征。MIAs的有效性已在图像、文本和图等多个领域得到证实。这些攻击凸显了神经网络的脆弱性，并提高了研究界对隐私泄露风险的认识。本综述基于威胁模型和假设，对攻击与防御进行了综合梳理。我们比较了暴露接口、攻击者知识、重建先验与目标、失败模式、部署约束以及隐私-效用权衡，并重点强调了这些方面。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了模型反演攻击的威胁模型、方法分类及防御策略，并比较了不同攻击场景下的接口、知识与权衡，为隐私保护研究提供了全面参考。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews threat models, attack methods, and defense strategies for model inversion attacks, comparing interfaces, knowledge, and trade-offs across scenarios to provide a comprehensive reference for privacy research.
